memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: Its drink offering is to be half a hin of wine with each bull, a third of a hin with the ram and a quarter of a hin with each lamb. This is the monthly burnt offering to be made at each new moon during the year. Besides the regular burnt offering with its drink offering, one male goat is to be presented to the LORD as a sin offering. - Num 28:14-15 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Alongside the monthly burnt offering, a goat was to be offered as a sin offering. Even in the joyful marking of a new month, sin could not be ignored. The people needed continual atonement, a regular reminder that they were sinners in need of forgiveness. Worship and the acknowledgment of sin went together.

This is a sobering but important truth. Israel's worship never let them forget their need for cleansing. Month after month, the sin offering reminded them that they could not approach God on their own merit. They needed a covering for their sin, provided by God's gracious appointment. Worship was possible only because atonement was made.

Yet notice how these repeated sacrifices reveal their own insufficiency. If one sacrifice were enough, why offer another the next month? The very repetition showed that these offerings could not finally take away sin; they could only point forward to something better (Heb 10:1-4). They were shadows awaiting the true substance.

That substance is Christ. He offered one sacrifice for sins forever, and then sat down at God's right hand, His work complete (Heb 10:12). We no longer need repeated sin offerings, for His one offering has cleansed us fully. What Israel could only anticipate, we now possess in Christ. Rejoice that your sin is dealt with once and for all by the perfect sacrifice of the Son of God.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do you recognise your continual need for God's cleansing?
2. How do the repeated sacrifices point you to Christ's once-for-all offering?
3. What does it mean that your sin is dealt with completely in Jesus?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord Jesus, thank You that Your one sacrifice for sins is enough forever. I no longer need repeated offerings, for You have cleansed me fully. Help me rest in Your finished work with gratitude. Amen.
